title: Checking if amAMM is enabled
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `BunniHook` contract `amAmmEnabledOverride` and `globalAmAmmEnabledOverride` are used to check if amAMM is enabled, taking precedence over the `hookParams.amAmmEnabled` value.
